about: Hand decisions about MHSP2 stat blocks and its Reference Summary, applied by scripts/msh/roster.py and scripts/msh/rosterbook.py after parsing. Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - ranks, numbers and labels, never the book's prose - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.

match     {page, header, kind?, label?, codes?}: a Roster Book block by its printed page and the start of its entry's header; kind 'line' is a one-line F A S E R I P grid and null the full block beside one; codes, the block's seven rank codes, tells apart two unnamed grids in one entry
{summary}: a Reference Summary row (PDF 67), by the name the chart prints
verdict   misprint          the block prints a Karma its own ranks contradict; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what R+I+P gives on each rank's standard number
as_printed        the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why
label             the grid has no printed name above it; 'label' names it from its entry's own text
summary_differs   the chart prints a value the Roster Book's block does not, and neither is a sum to check; 'printed' is the chart's, 'corrected' the block's as parsed, which is what is played
checked   the date the page image was read
